description: Season2Bounties: the open bounties on rival crews (prize in wei, expiry, crew id; the poster is not shown), plus the minimum prize and the allowed duration. A squad whose raid lands on that crew while the bounty is open splits the prize. Post one with prepare_bounty_post. Read only.

includeClosed.description: Also list paid, refunded and expired ones.

n.description: How many of the latest bounties to look at, 1 to 50 (default 20).
